query:
INSERT INTO revenueEntries (saleId, revenueAccountId, amount, entryType, description, entryDate)
SELECT 
  s.id as saleId,
  (SELECT id FROM revenueAccounts WHERE code = '4.1.02.001' LIMIT 1) as revenueAccountId,
  CAST(s.discountAmount AS DECIMAL(10,2)) as amount,
  'DEBITO' as entryType,
  CONCAT('Desconto Venda #', s.id) as description,
  s.saleDate as entryDate
FROM sales s
WHERE s.status = 'ACTIVE' 
  AND CAST(s.discountAmount AS DECIMAL(10,2)) > 0
  AND s.id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT saleId FROM revenueEntries WHERE entryType = 'DEBITO');
